answer.reason: The instance has a "Features" component (referenceName FeatureGrid) described as a "Grid of items," which renders a list of entries from the "Feature Item" content model (referenceName FeatureItem). That model's fields are Title, Description, Icon (ImageAttachment), and Link — exactly matching what's needed for a capabilities-grid entry like "Webhooks" with an icon. No "Capabilities"-specific model exists on the instance, and no other model combines a name/title with an icon field in a grid-style component, so FeatureItem is the correct home for the new "Webhooks" capability content item.
